svg.title: lgtv-mcp architecture
svg.desc: Claude desktop and Claude Code talk to the lgtv-mcp server on a Mac mini over MCP. The server drives an LG webOS TV over SSAP, wakes it with Wake-on-LAN and finds it with SSDP. A launchd job runs the weekday morning briefing, which gathers calendar, weather and headlines from the internet and serves a page that the TV's browser loads. Screenward provides TMDB movie discovery for movie night, and play_title looks up streaming ids on Wikidata.
svg.text: Claude ↔ Mac mini ↔ LG webOS TV · 30 MCP tools · everything stays on your home network
